plan.rationale: Second plan per staged policy: baseline attempt-00 passed numerically, compiled with 32768 smem/122 regs, simulated 2558.09 us at 128x64x64, stages=1, swizzle=0 (3 blocks/SM). Retain core tile/stage/thread domains and hold equal weights (no measurements yet justify reweighting). Only change: introduce swizzle [4,8,16] to test whether serpentine panel locality improves the analytic reuse and reduces simulated DRAM traffic on this 4096^3 workload. Tiles still divide M=N=K=4096; shared-memory estimate gates oversized combos via HiGHS under the 32768 cap (also within the 32768 hard portability cap). Deduplication note: M/block_M ranges 32-128 tile rows, so swizzle 4/8/16 are distinct panels here, not launch-equivalent. Hypothesis: nonzero panel reuse should lower traffic cost and simulated dram_mb; if simulator traffic/latency does not improve, the locality proxy is misleading and I will change the thread or block_K domain next rather than sweeping more swizzles. Simulation values are GB10 estimates, not hardware measurements; Metal checks validate source but do not execute CUDA binaries.
